text: A carved copper-and-wood lantern that lights the camp at level **15** and never needs fuel or Pulse. Its crystal glows in the same colours as the living lattice.

pages.title: Using it
text: Set them along the paths between workshops. A lever or any redstone signal dims one, and a comparator reads 15 while it is lit.
It is a light, not a ward: hostiles still need darkness to spawn, so light plus a Hush Totem makes a quiet camp.
If you would rather your lights ran on the lattice, the Glow Reed, Shard Lamp, Echo Sconce and Ember Bowl draw a trickle of Pulse instead. See [Pulse lights](pulse_lights).
